purpose: C.9 Example 10 (fuel card with surcharge + capped refund rule): stacks_with_base (fuel_refund adds on top of base, not instead of it), a monthly reward-measure cap with zero overflow trimming the refund, a fuel surcharge (Stage 10), and a waiver threshold, all together on one card.

assumptions.note: Fuel ticket 1,500 and grocery ticket 700 are both exact multiples of Rs100 at these percentage rates (1500*0.005=7.50, 1500*0.01=15.00, 700*0.005=3.50 -- all terminate at 2dp already), so there is zero paisa floor loss anywhere -- no rounding_estimated flag expected. No exclusions on this card, so waiver-eligible spend is simply all spend.

_hand_computation: Stage 3 (match): fuel spend matches BOTH base (selector={}) and fuel_refund (categories=[fuel], stacks_with_base=true) -- base binds as the non-stacking winner (fuel_refund isn't in that contest at all), fuel_refund binds alongside it. Grocery spend matches only base.
Stage 4 (accrue), monthly: fuel base = Rs30,000 * 0.5% = Rs150.00. fuel_refund (uncapped) = Rs30,000 * 1% = Rs300.00. grocery base = Rs5,000 * 0.5% = Rs25.00.
Stage 5 (cap): cap_refund = Rs250/month on fuel_refund, overflow=zero. Rs300 > Rs250 every month -> capped to Rs250/month, the Rs50/month excess simply discarded.
Annual gross reward = (150 base-on-fuel + 250 capped-fuel_refund + 25 base-on-grocery) * 12 = 425 * 12 = Rs5,100.00 (cashback_inr, v=1).
Stage 10 (surcharge): fuel_sur = 1% on fuel, 18% GST on the surcharge itself. SurchargeCost = 0.01 * 1.18 * Rs3,60,000 (annual fuel spend) = Rs4,248.00.

Stage 6-7 (waiver): waiver-eligible spend = all spend (no exclusions on this card) = 3,60,000+60,000 = Rs4,20,000 >= Rs50,000 -> fee waived. fee_paid = 0 in both Year-1 and steady-state (joining_fee also unset, defaults to 0).
NACV Year-1 = 5,100.00 - 4,248.00 - 0 = Rs852.00 (identical -- no fee either year).
